data: Which line in the graph labeled (a) TP1 represent the fastest CPU times?

The question asks which line in the graph labeled (a) TP1 represents the fastest CPU times. From the caption, we know that the graph shows the average CPU time on the PKU dataset by varying C on five randomly sampled training and testing datasets. The lines in the graph correspond to different algorithms: CRF(I2), CRF(I1), IRW-CRF, SVM^hmm, MTL^hmm, and OnlineMKL.

To determine which line represents the fastest CPU times, we need to look at the y-axis, which is labeled "CPU Time (in seconds)" and ranges from 10^1 to 10^5. The faster the CPU time, the lower the value on the y-axis.

By examining the graph, we can see that the OnlineMKL line (blue) consistently has the lowest values on the y-axis across all values of C. This indicates that OnlineMKL has the fastest CPU times among the algorithms shown in the graph.

Therefore, the line labeled OnlineMKL in the graph labeled (a) TP1 represents the fastest CPU times.
